answers.question: Is this a net-metered (solar) connection or a standard connection? How did you tell?
answers.answer: This is a standard (not net-metered) connection. The bill shows a single import meter reading under the regular tariff A-1A(01), with no export units, no export reading and no net-metering credit.

answers.question: Which month in the last 12 months had the highest units consumed?
answers.answer: Aug 2026 had the highest consumption in the last 12 months (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026): 246 units.

answers.question: How much fuel adjustment am I being charged (shown as FPA or FCA on the bill), and for which month?
answers.answer: You are charged Rs 599 as FPA (fuel price adjustment). It relates to Jul 2026.

answers.question: If I don't pay on time, what late payment surcharges will be added?
answers.answer: If you pay late (due date 24 Sep 2026), the surcharge is Rs 336 until 28 Sep 2026 (total Rs 8,939); then Rs 671 after 28 Sep 2026 (total Rs 9,274).

answers.question: Am I consuming more units than in the same month last year?
answers.answer: Yes. You used 177 units this month versus 172 units in Sep 2025: 5 more units (+2.9%).

answers.question: What are my average monthly units consumed, and how does this month compare?
answers.answer: Your average over the previous 12 months (Sep 2025 – Aug 2026) is 156.9 units per month. This month's 177 units is 20.1 units (12.8%) above average.

answers.question: How many more units do I consume in summer (June-August) than in winter (December-February)?
answers.answer: You use 277 more units in summer than in winter (1.7× winter). Summer (Jun 2026 – Aug 2026): 677 units, 225.7 per month. Winter (Dec 2025 – Feb 2026): 400 units, 133.3 per month. That is 92.3 units per month more in summer.

answers.question: Looking at the payments for the 12 months shown on the bill, have I been paying every bill?
answers.answer: No. Across the 12 months shown (Sep 2025 – Aug 2026), no payment is recorded for May 2026 (1 of 12 months).

answers.question: Have my units consumed gone up or down over the last 3 months?
answers.answer: Mixed, down overall. Units went 243 (Jul 2026) → 246 (Aug 2026) → 177 (Sep 2026): -66 units (-27.2%) across the 3 months.

answers.question: Based on the 12 months trend, how many units should I expect to consume next month?
answers.answer: About 156 units in Oct 2026. Method: Oct 2025 used 152 units, and this month is +2.9% versus the same month last year (177 vs 172), so 152 × 1.029 ≈ 156.

answers.question: If I wanted to spread my electricity cost evenly across the year, how much should I set aside each month?
answers.answer: Set aside about Rs 4,896 per month. Your electricity cost over Oct 2025 – Sep 2026 comes to about Rs 58,750 (all from the billed amounts printed on the bill), divided by 12 months.

answers.question: If I consume the same units as last month, what would my bill be roughly?
answers.answer: Roughly Rs 11,957 for 246 units (the same as Aug 2026). This scales this month's charges and taxes (Rs 8,603 for 177 units) by units used; a different tariff slab or fuel adjustment can change it. For reference, your actual bill for Aug 2026 was Rs 11,926.
